workflow_definition.aggregation_logic: Leaf artifacts are refined upward one level at a time. Internal nodes aggregate only their direct children. No sibling or backflow exchange is allowed.
conditional_edges: manager_dispatch -> manager_nodes (parallel Send fan-out) else worker_dispatch
worker_dispatch -> worker_nodes (parallel Send fan-out) else worker_relay
termination_checker -> manager_dispatch | finalize
workflow_definition.dispatch_logic: Root routes only to managers, managers route only to their own children, and aggregation always follows the parent-child DAG upward.
stopping_criteria: No meaningful change between root artifacts
